email_body:
Hello,

I'm applying for the Graduate Engineer role advertised on SEEK. The ad describes estimating, tender documents and document control on façade drawings for graduates with up to two years' experience, and that is the work my study prepared me for.

I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026, where I prepared cost estimates and bills of quantities, reviewed technical drawings, and drew road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater designs in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards. My degree is a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019). On site in the Philippines from April 2019 to February 2020 I reviewed structural and architectural drawings, tracked procurement and materials, kept material records and progress reports, and coordinated with suppliers and subcontractors.

I have no façade experience and no work experience in Australia yet, and I haven't used Aconex or Procore. I use Excel and Word. I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I'm based in Melton, Victoria and open to discussing relocation to Sydney.

My drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. I'd welcome a conversation about the estimating team.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077

paragraphs: I'm applying for the Graduate Engineer role advertised on SEEK. Your website shows CCYE as a fit-out and cladding subcontractor with its own metal and joinery factories, and the ad describes estimating, tender documentation and document control on façade drawings for graduates with up to two years' experience. That is the side of engineering my study prepared me for.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute. The coursework included cost estimates and bills of quantities, risk registers, and reviewing and preparing technical drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards. Reading a drawing set and putting quantities and costs against it is work I have done in study. Before the diploma I completed a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering in the Philippines in 2019, which covered structural principles and construction methods.

My site experience is from the Philippines, April 2019 to February 2020, as project-in-charge on a community hall renovation and then field engineer on subdivision finishing works. I reviewed structural and architectural drawings and checked the work against them, tracked procurement and materials, kept material records, site reports and progress reports, and coordinated with suppliers and subcontractors. Keeping those records straight is the closest I have come to document control.

Where I fall short of the ad: I have no façade experience and no work experience in Australia yet, I have not used Aconex or Procore, and my degree is from 2019 rather than this year, though my Australian qualification is. I use Excel and Word. I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence with my own transport, and full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I'm based in Melton, Victoria and open to discussing relocation to Sydney.
My resume is attached and my drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. I'd welcome a conversation about the estimating team and what a graduate's first months would look like.

checklist: Decide first whether you would move to Sydney: the letter and email say "open to discussing relocation to Sydney". If the answer is no, do not apply.
The ad asks for Professional Engineer in Training status or willingness to pursue it. The letter says nothing about it; decide your real answer before applying and be ready to say it if asked.
Attach the two PDFs from this record (resume and cover letter).
Paste the screening answers above and fill the notice placeholder.
Press Applied on the tracker with the date and "SEEK".
notes: CCYE (ccye.com.au, Rhodes NSW) is a plasterboard, cladding and joinery fit-out subcontractor (NSW licence class Dry Plasterer), not an engineering consultancy; the SEEK "civil/structural engineering team" wording is classification language. The role is graduate estimating and document control on façade drawings, 0 to 2 years, recent graduates encouraged. Fit lowered to 62 for the industry mismatch; Marc decides whether a fit-out estimating start suits him. The ad's "Professional Engineer in Training status or willingness to pursue" is left to Marc. No published contact beyond info@ccye.com.au (not stated to take applications), so SEEK is the only route. Interstate: Sydney relocation is Marc's call.
